rationale: The answer correctly identifies T1613 (Container and Resource Discovery) as the ATT&CK anchor and demonstrates the CAPEC source returned zero records via the executed Gremlin query (g.V().hasLabel("TaxonomyEntry")...in("MAPS_TO")).
